findings.userFacingImpact: A screen-reader user may encounter the required email field without its visible purpose being announced.
findings.observedCondition: The input has zero associated labels and no aria-label or aria-labelledby value; axe reports the label rule for #email.
findings.expectedCondition: The visible Email address text is programmatically associated with the email input and supplies its accessible name.

findings.userFacingImpact: A keyboard user may be unable to visually locate the primary action before continuing.
findings.observedCondition: The focused control computed outlineStyle=none, outlineWidth=3px, and boxShadow=none; no visible outline or box-shadow indicator was detected.
findings.expectedCondition: The keyboard-focused primary action has a clearly visible focus indicator without changing unrelated controls.

sourceContext.selectionBasis: Allowlisted excerpt containing only the controlled focus-style rule.

confidenceBasis: The keyboard journey confirmed the primary action held focus.

requiredAutomatedVerification: Verify keyboard focus on Continue to confirmation has a visible outline or box-shadow.
Rerun the predefined checkout keyboard journey through confirmation.
requiredHumanReview: Confirm the focus indicator is visually clear against the primary button in relevant states.
Review keyboard usability with qualified human judgment; automation alone is incomplete.
